# Auth Checklist: Login/Register

**Purpose**: Validate requirements clarity and completeness for login/register flows (API + UI + security)
**Created**: 2026-05-18
**Feature**: [specs/001-login-register/spec.md](specs/001-login-register/spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are required login inputs (username, password) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are required registration inputs for User explicitly specified (full name, phone)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are required registration inputs for Worker explicitly specified (job type, professional certificate PDF/image upload)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are required validation rules for username, password, and phone specified in the requirements? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are duplicate-constraint requirements specified for both username and phone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are refresh and logout behaviors fully specified as requirements (issue, rotate, revoke)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the lockout threshold defined with a numeric failed-attempt count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the lockout duration defined with a specific time window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Are Vietnamese UI message expectations defined with scope and examples? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Is worker verification status messaging defined clearly (content + when shown)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do login requirements align with lockout and throttling requirements (no conflicts)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Are success criteria consistent with the performance goals stated in requirements? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are registration requirements consistent between User and Worker flows (shared fields vs role-specific fields)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Are acceptance scenarios measurable for sign-in success and failure? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK015 Are acceptance scenarios measurable for duplicate username/phone registration attempts? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK016 Are acceptance scenarios measurable for worker verification pending status? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK017 Do success criteria define measurable thresholds for sign-in latency and completion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for both User and Worker registration paths? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for refresh token rotation and reuse rejection? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK020 Are logout requirements defined for both access and refresh session invalidation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for missing or invalid inputs on login/register? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for network failure during login/register? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for repeated failed sign-in attempts within the lockout window? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for expired or revoked refresh sessions? [Gap]

- [ ] CHK028 Are UI responsiveness requirements defined for mobile/tablet screens? [Gap]
